News that an mRNA cancer vaccine developed by Merck & Co. and Moderna Inc. kept melanoma from returning in a large, late-stage trial marks a critical next chapter for a technology beleaguered by post-pandemic political backlash and years of false starts before then. He also made a commitment that the beef will be sold at 25% below current market prices. Agriculture Reporter Ilena Peng and Howard Capital Management CEO Vance Howard -- who owns a ranch of his own -- discuss how much the tariff relief will impact costs, and what it may do to American farm businesses. (Source: Bloomberg)

He emphasized the dramatic increase in franchise values over the decades, noting that when he started in 1976, NFL expansion teams were purchased for $16.5 million, compared to recent sales reaching into the billions. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Permanent Tariffs on Canada Hurt the US, Freeland Says
title_cn: 弗里兰表示，对加拿大的永久关税伤害了美国
summary: Former Canadian Deputy Prime Minister Chrystia Freeland, talks about the importance of Canada reaching a trade deal with the US. She says putting permanent tariffs on Canadian steel and aluminum will hurt the US, especially car manufacturers in Detroit. She speaks on Bloomberg Television’s Wall Street Week With David Westin, to which she is a regular contributor. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trade Deal to Leave ‘Bad Outcome’ for Canada and US, Ex-Minister Says
title_cn: 前部长表示，贸易协议将为加拿大和美国留下“糟糕的结果”
summary: Mark Carney is doing what no previous Canadian leader has done by accepting that President Donald Trump can impose tariffs despite the terms of the North American trade pact, the country’s former deputy prime minister said.

title: Germany Says Weapons Cache Points to Hybrid Attack Plans
title_cn: 德国称武器储藏点指向混合攻击计划
summary: Germany’s top security official confirmed the discovery of a cache of weapons on the outskirts of Berlin and said authorities are investigating the possible involvement of foreign security agents in a range of planned attacks.

title: Piracy Observer Says Somali Incidents Rising as Navies Stretched
title_cn: 海盗观察员称索马里海盗事件增多，海军捉襟见肘
summary: The world’s top maritime piracy observer said incidents off the coast of Somalia are on the rise again after a pair of fresh attacks this week — as two major regional conflicts stretch naval forces in the area thin.

title: Iran’s President Says Better to End War Today
title_cn: 伊朗总统表示最好今天结束战争
summary:
Iran’s president urged an end to the war with the US, in his latest pushback against hardliners who want to continue the conflict.

“It would be better to end the war today, when we have power and dignity, and with the whole world acknowledging our victory,” Masoud Pezeshkian said, according to the semi-official Iranian Students’ News Agency.
 
Pezeshkian, along with Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and lead negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, have been vocal advocates of ending the war through diplomacy and prioritizing economic recovery since the signing of a now-collapsed ceasefire. His comments come as the conflict shows no sign of a quick resolution and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to unveil plans to economically isolate Iran and its trading partners. We get the latest from Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: MBS, Macron to Sign Bilateral Deals, Address Energy Routes
title_cn: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼与马克龙将签署双边协议，解决能源路线问题
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron and Saudi Arabian Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman are set to oversee the signing of bilateral deals and discuss alternative routes to the disrupted Strait of Hormuz during talks on Monday.

title: How Germany Lost Its Industrial Edge
title_cn: 德国如何失去工业优势
summary: Fierce competition from China and high energy costs are just two of the reasons Germany’s famous industrial machine has stalled. How did this crisis come to pass, and can Germany adapt in time? (Corrected to replace image of German currency at 1:17) (Source: Bloomberg)
